approximation.variable_tail_bootstrap_discount: gamma=1, including shorter terminal and budget-end tails
approximation.boundary: Original one-step replay or on-policy rollout collection.

action_mapping.inputs: current equipment, SOC, temperature, ramp, PCC, reserve, terminal reachability and FIFO deadlines only

training.algorithm: Constrained BC warm-start + PPO balanced safe policy improvement

physical_config.claim_boundary: V3.2候选先在2024-2025训练/验证段调优，再一次性打开2026年1-5月公开前向窗口。公开数据不含岸电表计、BMS、PCC结算或控制回执；任何候选均不得据此宣称上海港现场节省。

physical_config_legacy_fields.actual_optimizer_configuration: top-level algorithm_parameters and recorded per-checkpoint parameters

config.optimizer_update_count_basis: actual PyTorch optimizer step post-hook calls

access_protocol_details.historical_csv_bytes: Complete 2024-2025 CSV physically loaded; full-table quality checks performed.
access_protocol_details.historical_test_partition: August-December 2025 rows excluded from gradients, normalization and model selection; evaluated only after formal selection.
access_protocol_details.forward_csv_bytes: Separate 2026 CSV is not loaded in pilots; formal evaluation loads it after selection freeze.
access_protocol_details.test_status_not_opened_meaning: No test-partition policy evaluation; does not claim historical CSV bytes were never read.

parameters.network_structure:
SACPolicy(
  (actor): Actor(
    (features_extractor): FlattenExtractor(
      (flatten): Flatten(start_dim=1, end_dim=-1)
    )
    (latent_pi): Sequential(
      (0): Linear(in_features=31, out_features=128, bias=True)
      (1): ReLU()
      (2): Linear(in_features=128, out_features=128, bias=True)
      (3): ReLU()
    )
    (mu): Linear(in_features=128, out_features=2, bias=True)
    (log_std): Linear(in_features=128, out_features=2, bias=True)
  )
  (critic): ContinuousCritic(
    (features_extractor): FlattenExtractor(
      (flatten): Flatten(start_dim=1, end_dim=-1)
    )
    (qf0): Sequential(
      (0): Linear(in_features=33, out_features=128, bias=True)
      (1): ReLU()
      (2): Linear(in_features=128, out_features=128, bias=True)
      (3): ReLU()
      (4): Linear(in_features=128, out_features=1, bias=True)
    )
    (qf1): Sequential(
      (0): Linear(in_features=33, out_features=128, bias=True)
      (1): ReLU()
      (2): Linear(in_features=128, out_features=128, bias=True)
      (3): ReLU()
      (4): Linear(in_features=128, out_features=1, bias=True)
    )
  )
  (critic_target): ContinuousCritic(
    (features_extractor): FlattenExtractor(
      (flatten): Flatten(start_dim=1, end_dim=-1)
    )
    (qf0): Sequential(
      (0): Linear(in_features=33, out_features=128, bias=True)
      (1): ReLU()
      (2): Linear(in_features=128, out_features=128, bias=True)
      (3): ReLU()
      (4): Linear(in_features=128, out_features=1, bias=True)
    )
    (qf1): Sequential(
      (0): Linear(in_features=33, out_features=128, bias=True)
      (1): ReLU()
      (2): Linear(in_features=128, out_features=128, bias=True)
      (3): ReLU()
      (4): Linear(in_features=128, out_features=1, bias=True)
    )
  )
)
parameters.sb3_update_counter_semantics: SB3 gradient iterations; actor/critic/entropy optimizer calls are counted separately
